function drawBombs(t){
  IMP.forEach(([ti,[ix,iy],col])=>{
    const a=t-(ti-FALL);if(a<0||a>FALL)return;
    const p=a/FALL,e=p*p;
    const sx=(ix+9)*W/100,sy=-70,tx=ix*W/100,ty=iy*H/100;
    const px=sx+(tx-sx)*e,py=sy+(ty-sy)*e,ang=Math.atan2(ty-sy,tx-sx);
    const im=col?bB:bR,sc=.6;
    x.strokeStyle='rgba(255,210,140,.35)';x.lineWidth=3;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(px-(tx-sx)*.07,py-(ty-sy)*.07);x.lineTo(px,py);x.stroke();

  });

const MA=.5,MB=.925;
function smokeAt(cx,cy,a,seed,sc){
  for(let k=0;k<10;k++){
    const age=clamp((a-k*.06)/2.4);if(age<=0)continue;
    const sy=cy-age*(150*sc)-k*6*sc,sr=(16+age*40+k*2)*sc,sa=.55*(1-age);
    const sx=cx+Math.sin(k*2.3+seed+a*1.2)*(14+age*22)*sc;
    const g=x.createRadialGradient(sx,sy,1,sx,sy,sr);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(55,45,42,'+sa+')');g.addColorStop(.6,'rgba(38,30,28,'+sa*.6+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(25,20,20,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.arc(sx,sy,sr,0,7);x.fill();
  }
}
function drawExplosions(t){
  IMP.forEach(([ti,[ix,iy]],n)=>{
    const a=t-ti;if(a<0||a>4.2)return;
    const cx=ix*W/100,cy=iy*H/100,sc=.5+.9*(iy/100);
    // crater with glowing rim, stays and fades
    const ca=clamp(a/.2)*clamp((4.2-a)/1.4);
    x.save();x.translate(cx,cy+4*sc);x.scale(1,.38);
    let g=x.createRadialGradient(0,0,2,0,0,46*sc);g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(15,6,2,'+.95*ca+')');g.addColorStop(.55,'rgba(40,12,3,'+.9*ca+')');g.addColorStop(.8,'rgba(255,110,20,'+.85*ca*(.8+.2*Math.sin(t*14+n))+')');g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(255,60,0,0)');
    x.fillStyle=g;x.beginPath();x.arc(0,0,46*sc,0,7);x.fill();x.restore();

    // white flash

    if(a<3.4){
      const p=ease(clamp(a/.9)),sw=(.22+.78*p)*(.11+.09*(iy/100)),sh=(.1+.9*clamp(a/.7))*(.11+.09*(iy/100));
      x.save();x.globalCompositeOperation='screen';x.globalAlpha=clamp((3.4-a)/1.2)*clamp(a/.08);
      x.drawImage(MUSH,cx-MA*1508*sw,cy-MB*940*sh,1508*sw,940*sh);x.restore();
    }
    // embers
    for(let k=0;k<22;k++){
      const ang=-Math.PI/2+(rnd(n*30+k)-.5)*2.4,sp=70+rnd(n*30+k+7)*170,d=sp*a*(1-a*.15),life=1-a/2.4;if(life<=0)continue;
      x.fillStyle='rgba(255,'+(150+rnd(k)*80|0)+',60,'+life+')';
      x.fillRect(cx+Math.cos(ang)*d*.8*sc,cy+Math.sin(ang)*d*sc+a*a*55,2.5,2.5);
    }
  });
}
function shake(t){
  let sx=0,sy=0;
  IMP.forEach(([ti])=>{const a=t-ti;if(a>0&&a<.55){const k=Math.pow(1-a/.55,2)*10;sx+=Math.sin(a*90)*k;sy+=Math.cos(a*77)*k*.7}});
  return [sx,sy];
}

function bar(t){

  const FY=FY0+(1-sl)*260;
  x.drawImage(fr,0,FY,FW,FHt);
  const ix0=248*sx_,ix1=672*sx_,iy0=FY+184*sy_,iy1=FY+284*sy_,my=(iy0+iy1)/2,ih=iy1-iy0;
  const prog=clamp((t-PS)/PD),pp=prog;
  const BL=Math.min(ih*3.1,112),bcx=(ix1-BL*.5)-pp*((ix1-BL*.5)-(ix0-BL*.62));
  x.save();x.beginPath();x.rect(ix0,iy0,ix1-ix0,ih);x.clip();
  if(pp>=0&&t>=PS-.05){
    // fire fills the black square: flame base at the bomb, trailing to the right
    x.save();x.beginPath();x.rect(Math.max(ix0,bcx),iy0,ix1-Math.max(ix0,bcx)+2,ih);x.clip();
    for(let k=6;k>=0;k--){
      x.save();x.translate(bcx+BL*.40+k*46,my+Math.sin(t*21+k*2)*.8);x.rotate(Math.PI/2);
      const fw=ih*1.55*(1+.05*Math.sin(t*26+k)),fh=(k?140:280)*(1+.05*Math.sin(t*17+k*3));
      x.globalAlpha=k?.9:1;
      x.drawImage(fire,-fw/2+Math.sin(t*13+k)*1.5,-fh,fw,fh);
      x.restore();

    x.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';x.globalAlpha=1;x.restore();
    // bomb (red atomic) pointing left, thickness = bar height so the fire comes out of its whole tail
    const bw=bR.width,bh=bR.height,ext=Math.abs(Math.sin(NOSE-Math.PI))*bw+Math.cos(NOSE-Math.PI)*bh;

    x.shadowColor='#ff9a30';x.shadowBlur=8;
    x.drawImage(bR,-bw*sc/2,-bh*sc/2,bw*sc,bh*sc);x.restore();
  }
  x.restore();
  const pct=Math.round(pp*100)+'%';
  x.font='bold 40px Arial Black, Arial, sans-serif';x.textAlign='center';x.lineWidth=7;x.strokeStyle='#2a0a00';x.lineJoin='round';

  x.fillStyle=g2;x.fillText(pct,W/2,ty);
}
